items.title: Applied Materials (AMAT) Stock Rises As Strong AI Demand Eases Hardware Slowdown Fears
items.summary: Applied Materials (NasdaqGS:AMAT) traded higher after CoreWeave reported strong earnings that eased worries about AI hardware demand. CoreWeave, a specialized cloud provider focused on AI workloads, highlighted ongoing customer spending on high-performance computing infrastructure. Investor interest rotated back into semiconductor equipment suppliers as CoreWeave's results pointed to resilient AI data center build-outs. items.summary: Applied Materials (NASDAQ:AMAT) reported record fiscal fourth-quarter revenue and forecast further growth, as demand for equipment used to make advanced chips and memory continues to outstrip supply. The semiconductor equipment maker expects wafer fab equipment demand to rise more than 30% in 2027
